521:t_021:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「I selfishly assumed you'd understand everything without my putting it into words.」

521:t_021:8.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...You have far too many fantasies about women.」

521:t_021:9.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Remember, just as you want to rely on women, there are women who want to rely on you.」

521:t_021:10.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's true even of someone the world calls an iron woman.」

521:t_021:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「Will you walk beside me, $$ハマーン$$?」

521:t_021:12.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...I've been waiting all this time for you to say that.」

521:t_022:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「Colonel $$シャア$$, if you've settled things, come here immediately.」

521:t_022:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「We've received word from $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$. $$アマルガム$$ has begun moving to destroy the world.」

521:t_022:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$アマルガム$$... It's that mysterious organization with ties to the $$新地球皇国$$, separate from $$ネオ・ジオン$$...」

521:t_022:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「But $$フル・フロンタル$$ has been in contact with them since the $$時獄戦役$$.」

521:t_022:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't tell me the battle against the Empire that $$フロンタル$$ started to mention was...!」

521:t_022:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「...So $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s actions in space were meant to draw our eyes away from $$アマルガム$$...」

521:t_023:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I'm not done yet! I can't go down before the Colonel's eyes!」

521:t_024:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Captain $$アンジェロ$$! You're still doing this!?」

521:t_024:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Shut up, $$バナージ・リンクス$$! The Colonel is everything to me!」

521:t_024:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You wouldn't understand! The Colonel saved me from darkness so deep I thought being born had been a mistake!」

521:t_024:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Blindly believing in $$フル・フロンタル$$ like that is limiting your potential!」

521:t_025:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You can't let what's right before you bind you! If we live more freely, people... can go much further!」

521:t_026:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The $$サイコ・フレーム$$'s light has changed...!」

521:t_026:2.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Huh...! The spare shields are moving on their own!?」

521:t_027:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That's impossible! What is this power!?」

521:t_027:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Did he control the shields with a $$サイコ・フィールド$$!?」

521:t_027:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
(As $$バナージ$$'s $$ニュータイプ$$ abilities awaken, the $$ユニコーン$$ evolves, and at the same time, it makes $$バナージ$$ evolve...)

521:t_027:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
(This is... the true meaning... of a $$ガンダム$$...)

521:t_027:4.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I won't forgive you...! I won't forgive you, $$バナージ$$!」

521:t_027:5.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You rejected the Colonel! I'll kill you with my own hands!」

521:t_028:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「He's... still in darkness, even now...」

521:t_029:0.en:
$$ヒル$$
「We can't let $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s flagship sink! Retreat!」

521:t_100:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$! You mustn't lead the world!」

521:t_100:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The world rejected the $$時の牢獄$$ because it seeks a future!」

521:t_100:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「If despair awaits beyond it, a proper leader's duty is to let them avoid that.」

521:t_100:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What we must do is overcome it! We can't hand the world to you when you don't understand that!」

521:t_101:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$, $$ハマーン・カーン$$. I'll purge all $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s defectors together.」

521:t_101:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「The organization you lead doesn't deserve the name of $$ジオン$$.」

521:t_101:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$... I can't entrust those who believe in $$ジオン$$ to you.」

521:t_101:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「I... No, we will save... both the people of space and the people of Earth!」

521:t_101:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Only someone prepared to make himself a vessel can do that, $$シャア$$!」

521:t_101:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「Don't flatter yourself, $$フロンタル$$! Don't think someone of your caliber can hold people's hopes!」

521:t_102:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$カミーユ・ビダン$$. At least you should come to me.」

521:t_102:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I refuse! You aren't the Colonel, and you aren't someone who can lead this world!」

521:t_102:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't think the name of the $$赤い彗星$$ suits a man who can't show us a future or dreams!」

521:t_103:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$リリーナ$$ is prepared to fight for a future of peace, even if it means shedding blood.」

521:t_103:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I can't accept lives being lost by following a dreamer like that.」

521:t_103:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Each person decides how to use their life. We don't need your permission.」

521:t_103:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I'll use my life to fight those who block the future.」

521:t_104:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It seems your unnecessary words confused $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$.」

521:t_104:1.en:
$$シン$$
「You're calling concern for a friend unnecessary!?」

521:t_104:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's a shame. He was destined to become my comrade.」

521:t_104:3.en:
$$シン$$
「Don't decide how $$レイ#pt136$$ should live! He chose of his own free will to fight alongside us!」

521:t_104:4.en:
$$シン$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$! I won't hand you the world or my precious friend!」

521:t_105:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$キラ・ヤマト$$. You're the boy $$ラウ・ル・クルーゼ$$ hated most.」

521:t_105:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「No matter how much I'm hated, I'll live...! And I'll fight for what I believe in!」

521:t_105:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「I sympathize with your circumstances...! But that doesn't give me a reason to forgive you!」

521:t_105:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'm not asking for that. But as long as you stand in my way, you must disappear.」

521:t_106:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You're an $$イノベイター$$. So you're the future of humanity that $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ dreamed of.」

521:t_106:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm me. I don't know exactly what $$イオリア$$ wished for.」

521:t_106:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「But of my own free will, I'll fight those who try to close off the future!」

521:t_106:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then I'll teach you reality, a dreamer who gained power beyond ordinary people.」

521:t_107:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'd heard about you, but you really seem to be one hell of a bastard!」

521:t_107:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Another $$ガンダム$$ pilot is here...!」

521:t_107:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「This $$ダブルエックス$$ is the bond between me and $$ティファ$$... It's the very power of our desire for a future!」

521:t_107:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Here I come, fake $$赤い彗星$$! I'll show you just how amazing the power of hope is!」

521:t_108:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Someone who can't envision a future can't lead everyone!」

521:t_108:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You speak as if you understand.」

521:t_108:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The person I know always showed us the ideal we should strive for!」

521:t_108:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If you can't do that, you aren't a vessel capable of bearing the world!」

521:t_109:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This machine's pilot... is improving...!」

521:t_109:1.en:
$n
「Of course I am. Unlike a certain someone, I'm trying to move forward, even a little at a time!」

521:t_109:2.en:
$n
「Here I come, $$フル・フロンタル$$! Before history leaves you behind, I'll make you a relic of the past!」

521:t_110:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You're in my way, $$ギュネイ・ガス$$!」

521:t_110:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't think you can beat me! You sided with $$フロンタル$$'s status quo, while I'm always looking ahead!」
